title: Units library: one registry, three new units
prompt: This is a small units-of-measure library (about 25 files). We need three new units: the nautical mile, the stone and the US cup (details in docs/UNITS.md, 'Wanted'), and test/new-units.test.js fails. Today a unit is defined in several places, so adding one means editing many files, and units added with registerUnit() only half work. Refactor so that every unit, built-in or added with registerUnit(), is defined once (in src/registry.js) and parse, format, convert, compare and sum all read it from there, as README.md describes; then add the three units. The public API in README.md must keep working exactly as documented, and every test must pass.
